title: Social Norm Bias: Residual Harms of Fairness-Aware Algorithms

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring 'Social Norm Bias' (SNoB) by computing the Spearman's rank correlation between an occupation classification algorithm's predicted probabilities and a 'gender norm scorer' (a predictive model trained to infer gender from pronoun usage in biographies) to evaluate if models favor individuals who adhere to the gender norms of the majority in a given occupation.
